findings.title: L2-R6-R2-MAJOR-2 closure — 6 F4 regression-guards uniformly SUBSTANTIVE-NOT-SHAPE
findings.body: L2-R6-R2-MAJOR-2 ground-truth-verified at HEAD 32bd9edb: 6 F4 regression-guard tests uniformly displayed SHAPE-not-SUBSTANCE pattern (2 const-tautology workspace-walkers + 4 trait-isolation arms). Rewrote all 6 to invoke production entry points (install_plugin, delegate_capability, engine.create_node, fs::read_dir source walkers) + assert observable consequences (typed error fire, counter increment, cascade-residue absence, source-walker count). Verified would-FAIL-on-revert demonstrations: (a) commenting out one `self.admit_write_chain(` call in engine_crud.rs → S1 walker FAILS with count 12/13 + per-file breakdown diagnostic; (b) commenting out `policy.check_per_delegation` wire-in at engine_caps.rs:572-590 → S3b arm 1 FAILS with `Ok(cid)` instead of expected typed deny; (c) commenting out `policy.check_install_consent` block at plugin_lifecycle.rs:967-973 → S3a arms 1+2+3+6 ALL FAIL (counter=0 / Ok(InstallOutcome) instead of typed deny / library not empty); (d) commenting out `(ports.install_record_replay_check)(&payload_hash)?;` at plugin_lifecycle.rs:949 → S2 arm 3 FAILS with observed=0. All 33 affected tests passing post-rewrite (23 benten-engine + 10 benten-platform-foundation).

findings.title: L9-r6r2-MINOR-3 closure — DSL #839 cross-language mirror tautology rewritten to cross-file TS source-scan
findings.body: Rewrote `dsl_839_error_code_mirror_matches_typescript_constant_literal` from `assert_eq!(E_DSL_BACKEND_REJECTED, "E_DSL_BACKEND_REJECTED")` (self-equality tautology where lhs IS the const + rhs IS its declared literal) to a real cross-file scan: reads `packages/engine/src/errors.generated.ts` at test time, locates the `EDslBackendRejected extends BentenError` class declaration, parses the `static readonly code = "..."` literal, asserts equality with the Rust `E_DSL_BACKEND_REJECTED` const. Now genuinely catches Rust↔TS cross-language drift (the §3.5g item 6 amendment); pre-rewrite was paper-only. Verified passing.
findings.would_fail_on_revert_demonstrated: Implicit — any rename of either Rust const value OR TS `EDslBackendRejected.code` literal without atomic update of the other side → assertion fires with both literals named in diagnostic

findings.title: L13-MAJ-1 closure — 18-of-34 F4 trait-isolation tests rewritten to invoke production entry points
findings.body: Trait-isolation rewrites: each test now constructs a real Engine (via EngineBuilder + capability_policy / capability_policy_grant_backed + tempfile-backed open) or runs the full plugin_lifecycle::install_plugin pipeline (with InstallParams + InstallPorts threading the test's policy/closure as the load-bearing wire). Production entry points exercised: engine.caps().delegate_capability + plugin_lifecycle::install_plugin + ProductionEngineBuilder::new().open + ProductionManifestEnvelopeRechecker::recheck_row + InstallPorts.install_record_replay_check via install_plugin. Forensic-discrimination arms now verify argument-forwarding contracts (canonical signing-payload BLAKE3 / `did:key:` plugin_did / source-principal-DID / target-plugin-DID / cap-scope). Ordering pins (S3a arm 6 + S3b arm 5) use observable side-effects (cascade-residue absence / typed-code divergence on private-namespace short-circuit). 18 affected tests; all passing post-rewrite.

findings.title: L13-MIN-4 closure — S1 arm 3 + S3c arm 3 const-tautology workspace-walkers rewritten to real fs::read_dir source-scans
findings.body: Both arms previously declared `const EXPECTED: usize = N; assert_eq!(EXPECTED, N)` — pure tautology. Rewritten using the `tests/phase_3_workspace/for_test_symbols_are_feature_gated.rs` source-walker precedent: walks `crates/benten-engine/src/*.rs`, counts non-definition consumer call-sites via line-scan, excludes `pub(crate) fn admit_write_chain(` / `fn check_write_with_audience(` definition lines, asserts count matches the declared expected value. Diagnostic includes per-file breakdown so a future drift names the offending file. Verified by mutation: commenting out one `self.admit_write_chain(` call in engine_crud.rs → S1 walker FAILS with `left: 12, right: 13` + per-file breakdown.

findings.title: L13-MIN-5 closure — 2 empty-body `#[test]` forensic anchors rewritten to substantive assertions
findings.body: Pre-rewrite: 2 `#[test]` arms with zero assertion bodies registering as PASS-by-vacuity (S3c arm 5 `ucan_grounded_excluded_per_delta_v3_7` + S3a arm 6 `install_consent_hook_fires_before_cap_cascade_documented`). Post-rewrite: (a) S3c arm 5 now reads `crates/benten-caps/src/ucan_grounded.rs`, locates every `policy.check_write*` consumer call, walks backward to assert each is inside `#[cfg(test)]` / `#[test]` / `mod tests` scope — a regression that lifted a policy call into production substrate code fires the assertion. (b) S3a arm 6 now uses observable side-effects of denial at step 3c: `library.is_empty()` AND `cascade.minted_grants().is_empty()` AND `cascade.provisioned_count() == 0` — proving cap-cascade (Step 9) was never reached. Reordering so consent fires AFTER cap-cascade → grants accumulate → cascade.minted_grants() non-empty → assertion fires.

findings.title: §3.6f strengthening — regression-guard test substantive-arm contract (4-sub-rule extension)
findings.body: §3.6f sub-rule extension (a)-(e): (a) production entry point invocation MANDATORY; (b) observable consequence MANDATORY; (c) would-FAIL-on-revert demonstrated in commit body; (d) NEVER `assert_eq!(N, N)` walker shape; (e) NEVER zero-assertion `#[test]` arms. Origins (16 instances across one wave's regression test family per HARD RULE 12 / §3.6h — ALL CLOSED in this PR). Memory file mints `feedback_pim_n_regression_guard_substantive_arm` with cross-links to pim-18 parent + pim-2 sibling + pim-12 sibling. MEMORY.md index entry one-line under '🟡 Load-bearing operational > Review composition + convergence' near pim-18.
